description: The Temple in the Sea is a pilgrimage site with history. As in a painting, the Hindu temple rises above the vast expanse of the sea before sunset. An aura of calm and prayer surrounds this special location which exists thanks to the stamina and devotion of a single man, the Indian worker Seewdas Sadhu. Listed opening hours: 7:30 AM - 4:30PM. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
